hierarchy.checkpoint: Retain each of three process outcomes; report passes/3, all3pass, mixed/all3fail, continuous mean/median/min/max and worst error. These are process repeats, not new learned policies.
hierarchy.method: Exactly three checkpoint/training-seed summaries. Report the three seed pass-count profiles and number of seeds with all3pass/mixed/all3fail. Aggregate seed-level process means and seed-level worst metrics descriptively; do not label nine processes as nine training seeds.
hierarchy.paired: Pair A1L/P_ONLY/A2 by training seed, comparing the three-process mean and worst summaries; retain every seed. Repeat-level block differences may be displayed, but statistical N remains3 training-seed pairs, with no CI or population significance.

order: Exact proposal27job order. Overall method positions are balanced3/3/3; pair-before counts are5:4 or4:5. Seed-specific perfect counterbalancing is not claimed.

missingness: Running/not-run/engineering-censored/missing or integrity-invalid jobs remain PENDING/NOT_RUN/INVALID with qualified task=null. Incomplete checkpoint groups cannot receive a zero fail count or a complete method comparison.
